subject: Renewal: ops assurance and 32-GPU commitment negotiation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: capacity conversation and options for Helix AI

Hi Lina —

Our records show your Dedicated Reserved Pool (current: Helix-Pool-1, 16 GPUs) is up for renewal on 2026-03-15. First — thanks for being an early Dedicated customer. I wanted to surface two paths before the renewal:

1) Renew the current 16-GPU commitment on the same cadence
2) Expand to 32 GPUs as part of the renewal to support your Q2 product launch (recommended for predictable throughput)

If youre considering expansion, we can provide a revised per-hour reserved rate, a staged ramp plan to avoid disruption, and explicit throughput guarantees (p95 latency, sustained concurrency) for the new pool. Ive looped in our solutions and pricing leads to prepare a tailored proposal.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync next week so we can go over pricing and the onboarding timeline? If youd prefer, reply here with the three things you need to sign off (pricing, SLA, billing terms) and Ill get a firm proposal over.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@helixai.com>

Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity conversation and options for Helix AI

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the heads up.

Short answers to your prompt: pricing, SLA, billing/proration. We want to double the pool to 32 GPUs at renewal (target go-live aligned with our April feature launch). Can you provide:

- Revised per-hour reserved pricing for a 12-month commitment (were open to 24-month if economics are compelling)
- Concrete throughput guarantees for the dedicated pool (what sustained QPS/throughput do you guarantee for 32 GPUs at 512-token sequences?)
- How billing/proration works if we place the PO mid-cycle and add capacity in phases

We have procurement involved (ops@helixai.com) and Carlos (engineering) wants clarity on the canary/ramp plan — minimal customer impact is critical.

Lina Gomez
Head of Product Operations, Helix AI
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, dev.patel@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Helix AI - pricing + ramp options (internal)

Tessa — needs numbers to send to Lina. Quick recommendation from Solutions + Pricing:

Summary (16 -> 32 GPUs)
- Baseline: Helix currently on 16 GPUs, monthly invoiced usage. They want 32 GPUs reserved at renewal.
- Name the new pool Helix-Pool-2 (32 GPUs) to isolate billing and tracing.

Pricing options (per-GPU reserved hour):
- Option A (12-month): $4.25 / GPU-hour (effective at pool activation).
- Option B (24-month): $3.95 / GPU-hour (best-effort pricing to lock economics).
- Note: prices assume standard NVX class GPUs (region: us-west-2). If they need higher-spec, we'll reprice.

Throughput & SLOs
- Throughput guarantee (baseline): sustained 460 tokens/sec per GPU for 512-token sequences at p95 CPU/path latency <= 120ms.
- Measurement: we will use Redwood traces + your submitted traffic profile to validate during a 2-week test window post-activation.
- SLO credits: 5% of that months reserved fees per missed SLO event, up to 25% monthly cap. Escalation path to Engineering on-call.

Ramp plan (to minimize risk)
- Week 0-2: Provision Helix-Pool-2 (8 GPUs active) + run validation with canary traffic in us-west-2
- Week 3-4: Increase to 16 GPUs (parallel with existing pool)
- Week 5-6: Move to full 32 GPUs and retire overflow to Helix-Pool-1
- Billing: proration applies on activation of each increment; we can provide a single blended invoice if they prefer.

Other terms
- One-time onboarding fee: $8,500 (invoiced with first month) — covers dedicated capacity onboarding and runbook creation. We can waive for a 24-month commitment.
- Early termination: standard carveouts; will provide draft amendment.

Attachments: Im attaching a draft throughput SLA matrix and proposal sketch for Tessa to send.

Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@helixai.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, ops@helixai.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: ops assurance and 32-GPU commitment negotiation

Lina — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a formal proposal (redwood_proposal_v3.pdf) and a short SLA matrix (throughput_sla_matrix.xlsx) with measurable targets and credit mechanics. Key points below so you have them at-a-glance: 

1) Pricing (per-GPU reserved hour)
   - 12-month: $4.25 / GPU-hour
   - 24-month: $3.95 / GPU-hour (includes onboarding fee waiver)

2) Throughput & SLO
   - Sustained baseline: 460 tokens/sec per GPU (512-token seq)
   - p95 path latency target: <= 120ms
   - SLO credits: 5% monthly reserved fee per missed SLO event; monthly cap 25%

3) Ramp & Billing
   - Staged activation (8 -> 16 -> 32 over 6 weeks); each activation prorated to activation date. We will provide a single blended invoice if you request.
   - Pool name: Helix-Pool-2 (isolated).

4) Onboarding & Ops
   - 2-week test window post-activation to validate traffic profile
   - Dedicated onboarding engineer and runbook delivery included

Next steps: If this looks good I can generate an amendment + PO instructions. We propose an activation target of 2026-04-06 to align with your product launch; if you need earlier we can compress the ramp to 3 weeks (additional validation hours billed).

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, pricing table, amendment)
             throughput_sla_matrix.xlsx (SLO measurement definitions)

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal: ops assurance and 32-GPU commitment negotiation

Tessa — this looks good. Helix is prepared to move to Option A (12-month at $4.25/hr) pending an internal PO. A couple quick items from procurement/engineering:

- Please include a 10-business-day test window clause (post-activation) to validate our peak traffic pattern.
- Wed like the invoice to be net-30.
- Can you confirm final activation date once you receive our PO? Well target April 6 but want to lock the test window into the amendment.

If you send an amendment and PO instructions Ill route through procurement today. Thanks for the quick turnaround — Carlos also says the staged ramp plan looks low-risk.

— Lina
Head of Product Operations, Helix AI
